datasetIdentity.manifestChecksumMethod: sha256 of sorted portable track ID, performer ID, duration, and chord-region JSON

candidates.description: Same architecture and objective as v1, retrained on each grouped fold.
Longer context plus within-chord distribution consistency.
Longer context plus supervised identity switching and stronger boundary targets.
All sequence objectives without probability filtering.
All sequence objectives, deterministic augmentation, and probability-domain EMA.

bootstrap.unit: paired performance clustered by held-out performer fold

longerReceptiveField.interpretation: Longer receptive field; all sequence-loss weights remain zero.

durationConsistency.interpretation: Duration-consistency loss added to the longer-context model.

boundaryAndSwitchSupervision.interpretation: Switch, hard-boundary, and boundary/state agreement losses added together.

combinedSequenceObjectives.interpretation: All sequence objectives added together without augmentation or smoothing.

augmentationAndEma.interpretation: Deterministic feature augmentation and EMA are added together; this contrast cannot isolate either component.

methodologicalLimitations: All p01-p05 performers overlap learned-model development; this is integration-domain development evidence.
